ideas.name: Example Invoice Follow-Up
ideas.product: A lightweight tool that reminds small businesses to follow up on overdue invoices.
ideas.problem: Small businesses lose time and cash manually tracking overdue invoices.
ideas.valueProposition: Automates polite payment reminders without requiring a full accounting platform.
ideas.topic: invoice follow-up and overdue invoice collection
ideas.startupCost: Static frontend plus inexpensive email/API usage; no heavy infrastructure.
ideas.seoAngle: People search for invoice reminder templates, overdue invoice workflows, and payment follow-up tools.
